configuration.description: Values used when each new event starts. They can be changed per event without affecting others.
configuration.reservationHelp: How long a place is held for someone who has not paid before releasing it.
configuration.paymentToleranceHelp: Shortfall accepted as valid. Zero requires the exact amount.
configuration.serviceFeeHelp: Added to each price tier plus the kit surcharge to form the final price. It is the starting value for each new event: every event stores its own fee, and changing this value does not affect events that already exist.
configuration.liabilityDescription: Copied when creating an event if the field is blank. An event cannot be published without it.
configuration.saved: Configuration saved. New events will start with these values.
configuration.suggestedLoaded: Suggested text loaded. Review it and save to apply it.
configuration.currencyHelp: ISO code shown next to every amount, e.g. USD or BOB.
